subject: Kochi yard expansion — board pack
body:
Hi Rohit — the board pack for the Kochi yard expansion is due Wednesday, and I want the working capital numbers in it to reflect the revised freight forecast, not the April baseline. Good stuff on the vendor consolidation, let's move fast on the remaining approvals and keep me posted on the treasury view. The capex committee only meets once this quarter, so we should land it there.

Thanks,
Vikram

subject: Quarterly business review
body:
Hi Priya — thanks for pulling the QBR deck together, the ops metrics section reads well and the vendor lead-time charts are exactly the story we want to tell the board this time. I'd like the same format kept for the October review, with the freight cost slide moved up front where the directors will actually look at it — keep me posted on the final numbers once Ananya's team signs off.

Thanks,
Vikram

subject: Supplier summit — keynote
body:
Hi Priya — I'm opening the supplier summit on the 12th and I want to acknowledge the top vendors by name, especially the ones who held deliveries through the monsoon disruption — Sundaram and Kalyani Forge deserve the call-out, good stuff. Draft me two lines for each so the citations feel specific, and let's move fast on the invite list before the venue locks the seats.

Thanks,
Vikram

subject: Orion Metals — offtake term sheet
body:
Hi Rohit — the Orion Metals term sheet landed and the offtake pricing is better than what we modelled in July, which is rare good news from that desk. I've asked legal to redline the exclusivity clause — the three-year lock-in is long for a commodity this volatile, and the board will ask about downside protection. Keep me posted on what finance thinks of the hedging leg.

Thanks,
Vikram

subject: Meridian anniversary note
body:
Hi Priya — for the anniversary note to all staff, I want to thank the yards and the finance team by name for the year we've had — nine years of Meridian and the best safety record in the group's history is not a small thing. Keep it warm, no corporate boilerplate. Let's move fast on the draft so comms has a week to translate it into Hindi and Tamil for the yard notice boards.

Thanks,
Vikram

subject: ESG rating — disclosure calendar
body:
Hi Priya — the ESG rating agency wants our emission disclosures a month earlier this cycle, and honestly it's good that they're pushing — the yard electrification numbers will read well against the FY24 baseline. Work with finance on the spend data and keep me posted on the timeline; the audit committee chair already asked about it, so we should not be late on this one.

Thanks,
Vikram

subject: Freight tender — decision
body:
Hi Rohit — on the coastal freight tender, I'm inclined to let Ananya's team make the final call on the rate card since treasury owns the exposure — I don't want the CEO's office distorting a commercial negotiation, that never ends well. Keep me posted once the L1 is locked. Good stuff on the bid analysis, by the way, the landed-cost model was the clearest I've seen this year.

Thanks,
Vikram

subject: Board dinner — logistics
body:
Hi Priya — for the board dinner on the 15th, confirm the venue does a quiet private room — half the agenda is informal follow-ups from the capex discussion and that works better over dinner than in the boardroom. Let's move fast on the seating chart, keep the auditors at my table, and keep me posted once the menu is fixed.

Thanks,
Vikram
